left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Age: 19~45
  -  Body weight: [AND]  55kg or higher(female: 50kg or higher) and BMI 18~27kg/m2
  -  SBP 90~150mmHg, DBP 60-95mmHg
  -  Fasting glucose 70~120mg/dL
  -  Infertility
       1
To prevent pregnancy, participants who agreed using 2 or more contraceptive methods

right.raw_text:
Such as
  -  Barrier methods: Condom, [OR]  Diaphragm, [OR]  Cervical cap (Pessary), Spermicide
  -  Hormonal methods: Pills, [OR]  Injection (Depot), Skin patch, [OR]  Hormonal implant (Implanon), Vaginal ring
  -  Intrauterine Devices (IUDs): Cooper IUD (Loop), Hormonal IUD (Mirena)
  -  Natural methods: Basic body temperature, [OR]  Ovulation period, [OR]  Coitus interruptus, [OR]  Abstinent
  -  People who perfectly understood clinical trial and independently decided to participate in clinical trial

left.raw_text: -  People who will be able to collect blood sample during clinical trial period

right.raw_text: -  People who are suitable to participate clinical trial by physical examination, [OR]  lab test  [AND] and medical examination by interview

left.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Genetic problems such as galactose intolerance, [OR]  Lapp lacatase deficiency, [OR]  glucose-galactose malabsorption
  -  Clinically significant disease such as liver, [OR]  kidney, [OR]  digestive, [OR]  pulmonary, [OR]  endocrine system, [OR]  cardiovascular disease etc
-  People who have gastrointestinal disease  [OR] or history of surgery which would affect absorption of drug

right.raw_text: -  History of clinically significant drug induced hyper-sensitive reaction  [OR] or drug related muscular disease
